title: Optimal Transport of Classifiers to Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmarks measure fairness in binary classification tasks with respect to demographic attributes like sex, race, age, and gender.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on algorithmic fairness concerning demographic attributes (sex, race, age) in machine learning classifiers.
